dataset_name: Illustrative delivery robot training records — unreviewed

records.title: Illustrative project assumption
records.description: Training assumption only: loss of sensing or communications may require a controlled stop. This is not a validated robot capability or approved safety requirement.

records.title: Camera failure
records.description: Camera unavailable in day, night or reduced visibility operation.

records.title: Reduced traction
records.description: Wet or rainy pavement may reduce available traction.

records.title: Processing delay
records.description: Processing delay can cause stale sensor data.

records.title: Insufficient obstacle detection
records.description: Hypothesis: camera failure, processing delay or reduced visibility could contribute to contact with a pedestrian.

records.title: Loss of remote supervision
records.description: Hypothesis: communication loss could prevent remote intervention.

records.title: Controlled-stop requirement candidate
records.description: Proposed requirement: command a stop on loss of critical sensing or communications; engineer must define physical capabilities and verify implementation.

records.title: Software watchdog state transition
records.description: Inject a stale sensor or lost communication condition; verify that the toy controller requests STOP. This tests software logic only.
